name: Kosmos-47
about: Kosmos-47 (1964-062A), a crewed vehicle (Voskhod), launched 1964 Oct  6. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1964 Oct  6), held fixed
